optimizedDescription.value: Guarded internal complete-metadata persistence validates projection then conditionally writes repository snapshot.

optimizedContext.value:
# Persist Spec Metadata
## Rules
- PersistSpecMetadata internal; only MaterializeSpecMetadata calls. Never Kernel/public Core/SDK/CLI/MCP export or general editor.
- Accept complete SpecMetadata plus expectedRevision; null creates absent snapshot, value replaces exact observed revision. No patches.
- Structurally validate before write; typed validation error and no write on failure.
- Delegate SpecRepository.writeMetadataSnapshot(spec, metadata, { expectedRevision }); no I/O, serialization, conflict detection, retries, merge. Propagate typed conflict.
- No dependency/optimization/projection authority. Explicit injected target-workspace SpecRepository.
## Constraints
- Never read artifacts/lock; complete replacement only; no CLI command.
